title.en: An Act Granting to the Estate of Floyd Engle, Represented By the Administrator F. J. Ferguson, a Franchise to Install, Operate, and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat, and Power System in the Municipality of Dulag, Province of Leyte, Philippine

text.en:
Subject to the conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, there is
hereby granted to the Estate of Floyd Engle, represented by the Administrator F. J. Ferguson, for a period of
fifty years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate
an electric light, heat, and power plant for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat, and
power for sale within the limits of the municipality of Dulag, Province of Leyte, Philippine Islands.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 28, 1930.
